discourse.title: Unity is Divinity
discourse.excerpt: The basic truth in all religions, irrespective of country or race, is one and the same. The philosophic ideas or the practices and methods of approach may vary. But the final objective and goal is only one. All religions proclaim the Unity of Divinity and preach the cultivation of Universal Love without regard to caste, creed, country or colour.
discourse.theme: All religions proclaim the unity of divinity — the Religion of Man.

reflection: All roads, Swami said at a gathering of the world's faiths, lead to the same Truth. The names differ, the forms differ, but the goal is one: universal love. So ask yourself: have you been dividing the One into compartments — my religion, my people, my way? Today, greet someone of another faith as a brother. That is the Religion of Man, and it is the only one that matters. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 16, 31 Oct 1983)

bhajan.title: Ishwar Allah Tero Naam (Sabko Sannmati De Bhagwan)

seva_nudge: Greet someone of a different faith warmly today and ask them one sincere question about their practice.
